{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a newer Fire 7, so this older tablet offers little reason to replace it.
ItemID: 2; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I regularly use memory cards for my devices, and another 32GB card with an adapter would be useful.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current interest is practical accessories for equipment I already use; I have no immediate need for a smart speaker.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My listed TV is 720p, and I am not currently looking to add a streaming device.
ItemID: 5; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A longer HDMI cable could help connect compatible devices around my TV, fitting my interest in useful cables and adapters.
ItemID: 6; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A newer smart speaker still does not address a current equipment or accessory need for me.
ItemID: 7; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a tablet and do not currently need another screen for calling or Alexa.
ItemID: 8; Title: NETGEAR Wi-Fi Range Extender EX2700 - Coverage Up to 800 Sq Ft and 10 devices with N300 Wireless Signal Booster & Repeater (Up to 300Mbps Speed), and Compact Wall Plug Design; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would consider this if I had a coverage problem, but I have no current reason to buy an extender.
ItemID: 9; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Owning a TV does not give me an immediate need for a streaming stick; I am focused on accessories right now.
ItemID: 10; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These could be useful, but I am not currently looking for headphones or replacing a pair."}
